🤝 My Machine Learning Journey | Major Project 2/2 | ProfileMatch – Intelligent User Recommendation System

Excited to share my second and final Major Project in my Machine Learning portfolio — ProfileMatch, a hybrid user recommendation system built using Machine Learning and Natural Language Processing (NLP).

The goal of this project was to recommend similar user profiles based on their skills, career goals, professional summaries, personality traits, location, and other profile attributes.

🔍 What I worked on:

• Performed data preprocessing and feature engineering
• Applied NLP techniques to user profile information
• Used TF-IDF Vectorization to convert profile text into numerical features
• Implemented K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) for finding similar profiles
• Used cosine similarity to measure profile similarity
• Incorporated MBTI compatibility into the recommendation process
• Considered location matching and income similarity
• Designed a hybrid scoring mechanism to rank recommendations
• Built an interactive Streamlit web application
• Added visualizations for recommendation scores, MBTI distribution, and common skills

⚙️ Hybrid Recommendation:

The final recommendation score combines multiple factors:

• 60% MBTI Compatibility
• 30% KNN Profile Similarity
• 10% Location Match

This project helped me understand how different Machine Learning and data-driven techniques can be combined to create a personalized recommendation system.

🌐 Streamlit Application:

I also developed an interactive interface where users can select a profile, generate recommendations, compare matching scores, and explore profile insights through visualizations.

💡 Key Learning:

This project strengthened my understanding of NLP, TF-IDF, KNN, cosine similarity, recommendation systems, feature engineering, data processing, and Streamlit.

More importantly, it showed me that Machine Learning is not limited to prediction — it can also be used to build intelligent systems that help users discover relevant profiles and connections.

🔗 GitHub Repository: https://lnkd.in/dk3KqVme

🙏 Acknowledgement

This project was completed as part of my Machine Learning learning journey. I'm grateful to UNLOX® and Sruthi Tarimana for their valuable guidance and for helping me build a strong foundation in Machine Learning.

With this project, I have now completed my 2 Major Projects and look forward to continuing my journey toward becoming an AI/ML Engineer.

I'd love to hear your feedback and suggestions!
